title: The Periodic Table of LLM Reasoning: A Structured Survey of Reasoning Paradigms, Methods, and Failure Modes
best_for_zh: 整理推理范式、方法、基准与失效模式的结构化综述。
one_line: A 2026 reasoning survey that maps paradigms, method families, benchmarks, and failure modes before readers enter data-specific tracks.
一篇把推理范式、方法趋势、评测与失效模式放入同一张表的 2026 综述。
why: It makes the distinction between a reasoning task label and the evidence needed to train or evaluate it explicit.
inclusion_reason: A 2026 broad reasoning map that routes new readers from paradigm labels to the data, verifier, environment, evaluation, and failure questions handled in specialized tracks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning research is often split by task names—chain-of-thought, multi-hop, math, code, retrieval, tools, or agents—while the data and evaluation assumptions beneath those names remain easy to miss. The primary source is the 2026 arXiv preprint https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11470. It asks how reasoning capabilities emerge across paradigms and where they fail.

The paper reports a systematic analysis of more than 300 recent papers and places reasoning paradigms, methodological trends, benchmarks, and failure modes in one structured survey. Its decision boundary is field orientation rather than an individual data release. The official arXiv record documents the survey.

推理研究常按 CoT、多跳、数学、代码、检索、工具或 智能体 等任务名称分割，而这些名称背后的数据和评测假设容易被忽略。主来源是 2026 年 arXiv 预印本 https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11470。论文讨论推理能力如何在不同范式中出现，以及它们会在哪里失效。

论文称其系统分析了 300 多篇近期工作，并将推理范式、方法趋势、基准与失效模式放入一份结构化综述。它的决策边界是领域导览，而不是具体数据发布。官方 arXiv 记录说明了这份综述。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The survey proposes a structured taxonomy covering chain-of-thought, multi-hop, mathematical, common-sense, visual, temporal, code and algorithmic, retrieval-augmented, tool-augmented and agentic, and reinforcement-learning-based reasoning. It connects those paradigms to trends in prompting, architecture, training objectives, reward modeling, and evaluation benchmarks.

Its feedback contract is indirect: it surveys how systems are scored or trained, but does not impose a common judge, reward, or terminal predicate. A key contribution is the connection between a paradigm label and its recurring failure surface, including reasoning hallucination, brittle multi-step inference, weak causal abstraction, and poor cross-domain generalization. The closest comparison is a post-training taxonomy; this Card uses the paper to route across reasoning modalities and failure questions.

综述给出结构化 分类框架，覆盖 CoT、多跳、数学、常识、视觉、时间、代码与算法、检索增强、工具增强和 智能体式 推理，以及基于强化学习的推理。它把这些范式与 提示词设计、模型架构、训练目标、奖励建模 和 评测 基准的趋势连接起来。

它的反馈契约是间接的：论文综述系统如何被训练或评分，但不施加统一 裁判模型、奖励 或终止谓词。其价值在于把范式标签与反复出现的失效面联系起来，包括 推理 幻觉、脆弱的多步推理、薄弱的因果抽象和跨域泛化不佳。最接近的比较对象是后训练 分类框架。

title: Method
方法
html:
The input is the surveyed research literature. The method organizes papers by reasoning paradigm, then synthesizes trends in prompting, architectures, training objectives, reward modeling, and benchmarks, and finally groups recurrent limitations. The output is a structured reference, not a dataset, benchmark harness, or executable method.

No new verifier, reward, judge, environment, code, or data artifact is released. When applying the taxonomy to a concrete system, write down the serialized object first—prompt, trace, answer, tool action, or episode—then identify who generated it and how it is evaluated. Check the cited primary artifact for split policy, hidden tests, model and sampling budget, license, data lineage, and contamination controls; none can be inferred merely from the survey's category.

输入是被综述的研究文献。方法先按推理范式组织论文，再综合 提示词设计、架构、训练目标、奖励建模 和 基准的趋势，最后归纳反复出现的局限；输出是一份结构化参考，而不是数据集、基准工具套件 或可执行方法。

论文没有发布新的 验证器、奖励、裁判模型、环境、代码或数据发布产物。将 分类框架应用于具体系统时，应先写下序列化对象是 提示词、轨迹、答案、工具动作还是 回合，再确定谁生成它以及如何评测。划分、隐藏测试、模型与采样预算、许可证、数据 脉络 和污染控制必须回到被引一手 发布产物核验，不能只由综述分类推断。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract specifies the more-than-300-paper scope, the listed reasoning paradigms, method dimensions, and four named failure patterns. Its arXiv record confirms the title, authors, June 2026 submission date, and preprint status. These are coverage signals, not validation of individual cited results.
官方摘要给出“300 多篇论文”的范围、所列推理范式、方法维度和四类具名失效模式；arXiv 记录确认标题、作者、2026 年 6 月提交日期和预印本状态。这些都是覆盖范围信号，不是对每个被引结果的逐项验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior surveys commonly isolate a task family or a technique. This paper's change is to combine diverse reasoning paradigms with methods, benchmarks, and failure modes in one “periodic table” framing. This makes it a recent direction signal that the field needs cross-paradigm navigation, especially when apparently similar scores arise from different data and evaluation contracts.

It does not introduce chain-of-thought, agentic reasoning, reward modeling, or the cited benchmarks, and it does not establish a universal taxonomy for data provenance. The authors state that their literature analysis draws on several scholarly and paper-indexing sources; primary-source verification remains mandatory before reusing a cited work. The work is an arXiv preprint with no confirmed archival venue.

既有综述往往只聚焦一个任务家族或一种技术。本文的新变化是在“元素周期表”式框架中同时组织多种推理范式、方法、基准和失效模式。这表明领域需要跨范式导航，尤其当表面相似的分数实际上来自不同数据和评测契约时。

它并未首创 CoT、智能体式 推理、奖励建模 或所引用的 基准，也没有建立数据 来源 的通用 分类框架。作者说明文献分析使用了若干学术与论文索引来源，因此复用被引工作前仍必须完成一手来源核验。该工作仍为 arXiv 预印本，尚无确认的正式 venue。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The survey covers heterogeneous modalities and task definitions, so one taxonomy slot can conceal different trace formats, data sources, and verification contracts. It is a 2026 snapshot; new benchmarks and agent environments may change the boundaries quickly.
综述覆盖异质模态和任务定义，因此同一 分类框架位置可能隐藏不同 轨迹 格式、数据来源和验证契约。它也是一份 2026 快照；新 基准和 智能体 环境 可能迅速改变边界。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The survey provides a structured taxonomy of reasoning paradigms, methods, benchmarks, and failure modes across language, visual, temporal, code, retrieval, tool, and agentic settings. Its categories describe the landscape of reasoning research. They do not supply the construction details of an individual dataset, model, or benchmark release.
综述为语言、视觉、时间、代码、检索、工具和 智能体式 设置中的推理范式、方法、基准与失效模式提供结构化 分类框架。这些类别描述推理研究的整体分布，不提供单个数据集、模型或 基准发布的具体构建细节。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Reasoning paradigms are only an entry point. Their deeper differences lie in whether they operate on prompts, traces, answers, or feedback; putting those objects in one table makes clear why similar-sounding methods may solve different problems.
推理研究中的范式名称只是入口，真正的差别还在于它处理的是提示、轨迹、答案还是反馈。把这些对象放进同一张表，有助于看清不同方法为何看似相近、实际解决的却不是同一个问题。
